as_told.title: Norton AFB meeting: Air Force asks Emenegger and Sandler to make a UFO documentary
as_told.place_text: Norton Air Force Base, California; the Pentagon

plain: This story is about two filmmakers, Allan Sandler and Robert Emenegger. A researcher who goes by UAPGerb says that in the early 1970s two US military officials came to them and asked them to make a documentary. The officials said they could include film from Holloman Air Force Base, and a man named Weinbrenner is mentioned. The podcast host Jesse Michels tells it as well: he says Emenegger was in contact with Norton Air Force Base, where everyone talked to him about UFOs, and that this led to a film called UFOs: Past, Present and Future, with J. Allen Hynek and Rod Serling also named. A third teller, the researcher Grant Cameron, relays what he says Emenegger told him. He places it at Norton around 1973 and names Paul Shartle, H.R. Haldeman and a Colonel Coleman, and he says the officials asked for the UFO film to be hidden among eight other documentaries. If true, it would mean the military itself quietly wanted the public to see UFO material.
